# beats.bitwrap.io

> Deterministic beat generator where the sequencer IS a Petri net executor.
> Every note is a transition firing; every rhythm is tokens circulating
> through places. No AI, no LLMs, no neural networks in the music — seeded
> PRNGs, Euclidean rhythms, music-theory rules, and explicit Markov chains
> with hand-tuned weights. Same genre + same seed = the same track, every
> time, offline, with no model in the loop.

Tracks are shared as a content-addressed `BeatsShare` v1 JSON envelope
(`@context: https://beats.bitwrap.io/schema/beats-share`). The CID is
`base58btc(CIDv1(dag-json, sha256(canonical-JSON(payload))))`, computed
identically in JS and Go; a `?cid=z…` URL reproduces byte-identical playback
in the browser. Minimum valid payload: `{"@context": …, "@type":
"BeatsShare", "v": 1, "genre": "techno", "seed": 42}`. Valid genres: ambient,
blues, bossa, country, dnb, dubstep, edm, funk, garage, house, jazz, lofi,
metal, reggae, speedcore, synthwave, techno, trance, trap.

## Docs

- [Full guide](https://beats.bitwrap.io/llms-full.txt): how the Petri nets
  make music, the share envelope, sealing a CID without the binary, the
  arrangement DSL, the public MCP endpoint, and the deterministic-provenance stance
- [Share schema](https://beats.bitwrap.io/schema/beats-share): content-negotiated
  — JSON-LD `@context` by default, `application/schema+json` for the Draft 2020-12
  JSON Schema, `text/html` for a rendered glossary
- [Share JSON Schema (static)](https://beats.bitwrap.io/schema/beats-share.schema.json):
  the wire-format contract for `BeatsShare` v1 payloads
- [Share JSON-LD context (static)](https://beats.bitwrap.io/schema/beats-share.context.jsonld)
- [Project schema](https://beats.bitwrap.io/schema/petri-note.schema.json): the
  runtime project shape — nets, places, transitions, arcs, MIDI bindings
- [Source](https://github.com/pflow-xyz/beats-bitwrap-io): Go + vanilla ES
  modules, no npm, no bundler

## App

- [Studio](https://beats.bitwrap.io/): generate, mix, perform macros,
  Auto-DJ, Feel pad, Stage view, share (`?cid=…`)
- [Feed](https://beats.bitwrap.io/feed): recently shared tracks
- [Archive](https://beats.bitwrap.io/archive): snapshot archive of the share store
- [Compose](https://beats.bitwrap.io/compose): multi-track composition view

## API

- [Share store](https://beats.bitwrap.io/o/): `GET /o/{cid}` returns the
  sealed envelope; `PUT /o/{cid}` seals a new one (server re-canonicalizes
  and rejects a CID mismatch; 10 PUT/min/IP, 256 kB max; CIDs are immutable)
- [Share card](https://beats.bitwrap.io/share-card/): `/share-card/{cid}.svg`
  or `.png` — 1200x630 Open Graph card for a sealed track
- [Public MCP endpoint](https://beats.bitwrap.io/mcp): streamable-HTTP MCP
  server with a stateless tool set — `generate_share` (genre + seed → sealed
  CID + playable URL), `list_genres`, `get_song`, `get_render_status`
- [RSS feed](https://beats.bitwrap.io/feed.rss): recently shared tracks as RSS

## Related

- [cdn.stackdump.com](https://cdn.stackdump.com): content-addressed host
  where rendered tracks are published at `/ipfs/<CID>/` — immutable, survives
  independently of this app; filter `/api/search?source=beats-bitwrap-io`
- [bitwrap.io](https://bitwrap.io): Petri nets as ZK containers — the parent
  project (editor + prover + Solidity generation)
- [pflow.xyz](https://pflow.xyz): visual Petri net editor and the shared
  browser Petri-net modules
- [book.pflow.xyz](https://book.pflow.xyz): Petri nets as a universal
  abstraction
